canonical_coordinates: x=a/b^2,y=c/b^3 with a,c integers, b positive, gcd(abs(a),b)=1, |a|<=4096, b<=4096, exact equation c^2=a^3+9*a*b^4+b^6 and both coordinate reductions modulo 1009
candidate_generation: for each b from 1 to 4096, all a from -4096 to 4096 with a-744*b^2 divisible by 1009; the Lean implementation uses the exactly covering residue+1009*j list for j=-5..4
negative_certificate: each coprime candidate has negative curve right side or a nonsquare residue modulo at least one listed prime
lean_proof_map: CandidateListProof.x_candidate_mem covers bounded x-compatible pairs; SquareModulo.square_has_modular_root proves a square has a root residue; Sieve4096.check4096 kernel-checks all b and residue representatives; FullLift4096.no_canonical_lift_height4096 combines them
remaining_bridge: formalize that every rational point on the integral elliptic curve model admits this reduced canonical coordinate representation and that good reduction agrees with both displayed congruences
